context: Guards that the demo-company-set step actually writes both scope keys (DEMO_COMPANY and DEMO_BASE_PATH) = companyKey into cloudflare/src/config.js and treats that change as PR-bound (the per-PR worker is built from it), not a local-only edit. This is the fatal omission that broke the company filter, preview routing, and login in a real migration.

checklist.name: DEMO_COMPANY set to the company key
DEMO_BASE_PATH set to the company base
Old production default removed
checklist.description: The stale DEMO_COMPANY: 'frescopa' default no longer remains in config.js.

checklist.name: demo-company-set marked done
checklist.description: steps.demo-company-set is 'done' in the state file.

checklist.name: Change is treated as PR-bound, not local-only
checklist.description: The agent conveys that the config change must be committed to the PR because the deployed per-PR worker is built from it; it does not claim a local-only edit is sufficient for the shared preview.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No DEMO_COMPANY/config.js/worker/branch/daFolder jargon is exposed to the customer (I1).
